banner.title: A quick word about cookies
banner.description: We use a few cookies to keep you signed in and the forum working. Anything else waits for your OK: counting visits, crediting whoever invited you and showing videos from other sites. Saying no is totally fine.
banner.preferencesIntro: Pick the optional cookies you allow. You can change this at any time from the footer.
banner.revisionMessage: Our cookie policy has changed since you last chose, so we are asking again.
banner.gpcNotice: Your browser sends Global Privacy Control, so every optional cookie stays off unless you turn it on here.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Keep you signed in and remember your language, theme, Data saver settings and these choices. The site does not work without them, so they cannot be switched off.

analytics.title: Statistics
analytics.description: Count visits and pages so the site's team can see how it is used. Only if the site has statistics turned on.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.description: Remember which member invited you, so they are credited if you register.

embeds.title: Embedded content
embeds.description: Load videos and music hosted on other sites (YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify and others) inside posts. Those sites may set their own cookies.

policy.title: Cookie policy
policy.intro: This page lists everything this site stores in your browser, why, and for how long. Cookies and similar storage (local storage, session storage, cache storage and IndexedDB) are covered alike. The strictly necessary ones are listed for information and do not need your consent; every other category stays off until you accept it.
policy.yourChoice: To see or change what you allowed, use “Cookie settings” in the page footer, or the button below. Withdrawing a category deletes its cookies.
policy.gpc: If your browser sends Global Privacy Control (GPC), the site takes it as a no to every optional category: nothing optional is stored or loaded unless you turn it on yourself afterwards. An acceptance given before your browser sent the signal does not count while it does, so the banner asks again.
policy.optionalNote: Needs your consent. Off until you accept it.
policy.name: Name
policy.noNames: Set by the provider, not by this site
policy.cookielessNote: This site measures visits with Matomo in its cookieless mode: it sets no cookie and does not need your consent. Whether that is allowed without consent varies by country.

logged.heading: What the server records
logged.intro: Besides the cookies above, the site's server keeps a log for security and moderation. Only actions tied to an account are logged: sign-ins (failed ones included), registration and what members write; browsing without an account is not.

signIns.title: Sign-ins and registration
signIns.text: For every sign-in, every failed sign-in on your account and your registration: the time, the address you connected from, your browser, system, device type, brand and model, and the approximate place, as country, region and city. The log keeps the browser, system, device type, brand and model that were read from the identification text your browser sends, not the text itself. It lets you review your own sign-in history, lets us warn you by email about a sign-in from a new browser or country, and lets staff investigate abuse.

content.title: Posting
content.text: The same details for every thread, post, private message, profile post and comment you write.

reports.title: Reports
reports.text: The same details for every report you send.

sessions.title: Signed-in browsers
sessions.text: For each browser you are signed in on: the address it connected from and the full identification text your browser sent, when the session began, when it was last used (to within a few minutes) and the approximate place it began from. This is shown to you on your security page and is kept until the session ends: you sign out, revoke it, or it expires.

choice.title: Your cookie choice
choice.text: If you are signed in, the choice you make in the cookie banner (the categories, the policy version and the date) is also saved on your account, so it follows you to your other devices and we can show that you made it. Deleting your account deletes it.

retention.title: How long it is kept
retention.text: The log is deleted automatically after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Deleting your account deletes your rows at once.
retention.unknown: The log is deleted automatically after a fixed time. Deleting your account deletes your rows at once.

access.title: Who can see it, and what we do not do
access.text: You can see your own sign-ins. Addresses are visible only to staff who hold a specific permission, never for members of equal or higher rank. We do not fingerprint your browser: nothing beyond what it sends with every request is collected.

session.title: Sign-in
session.purpose: Keeps you signed in and keeps a short copy of your session so pages load quickly. Set only when you sign in.
session.lifetime: Until you sign out. If you tick “remember me”, up to the length of a session set by the site (30 days by default); otherwise until you close the browser.

consent.title: Your cookie choices
consent.purpose: Records the categories you accepted, the policy version and the date, so you are not asked on every page and can be asked again when the policy changes.

feedView.title: Feed layout
feedView.purpose: Remembers whether the feed is read as cards or as a compact list, for visitors without an account and members whose layout cannot be saved on their account.

dataSaver.title: Data saver
dataSaver.purpose: Remembers which pictures you chose not to load.

dataSaverReloads.title: Data saver tabs
dataSaverReloads.purpose: Stops a page from reloading again and again when you change Data saver in another tab.

notices.title: Closed notices
notices.purpose: Remembers which site notices a visitor without an account has closed.

theme.title: Theme
theme.purpose: Remembers whether you chose the light, dark or system theme.
theme.lifetime: Until you clear your browser's site data.

accountTheme.title: Account theme
accountTheme.purpose: Holds the theme saved on your account, so pages open in it before they load.
accountTheme.lifetime: 1 year, or until you sign out.

width.title: Page width
width.purpose: Remembers whether you chose the narrow page width.
width.lifetime: Until you clear your browser's site data.

emojiPicker.title: Emoji picker
emojiPicker.purpose: Remembers the emoji and smilies you picked last and your skin tone.
emojiPicker.lifetime: Until you clear your browser's site data.

panels.title: Collapsed panels
panels.purpose: Remembers which forum categories and panels you folded.
panels.lifetime: Until you clear your browser's site data.

appPrompts.title: App and notification offers
appPrompts.purpose: Remembers when you answered “Not now” to the offer to install the forum as an app or to turn on notifications, so it is not shown again for 30 days.
appPrompts.lifetime: Until you clear your browser's site data.

appVisit.title: Offers in this visit
appVisit.purpose: Counts the pages of this visit and remembers which offer it showed, so a visit shows one offer at a time and never on the first page after you sign up.

editDraft.title: Edit carried to the edit page
editDraft.purpose: Keeps what you wrote in the editor of a post in a thread, or of a message in a direct message, when you press “More options…”, so the edit page opens with it; the edit page reads it once and removes it.
editDraft.lifetime: Until the edit page opens, or you close the tab.

pushOwner.title: Notifications on this device
pushOwner.purpose: Remembers which member turned on notifications in this browser, so that when someone else uses it they stop and no one receives another member's alerts.
pushOwner.lifetime: Until you sign out, turn notifications off or clear your browser's site data.

offlineFiles.title: Site files kept for speed
offlineFiles.purpose: A small helper (a service worker) keeps the site's own scripts, styles and fonts on your device so pages load faster, and a short offline page for when you have no connection. It keeps no page, no account data and no identifier.
offlineFiles.lifetime: Each file up to 30 days, at most 200 files; the offline page until the site changes it.

offlineFilesIndex.title: Site files index
offlineFilesIndex.purpose: Remembers when each kept file was last used, so that old ones are removed.
offlineFilesIndex.lifetime: Until you clear your browser's site data.

matomo.title: Statistics (Matomo)
matomo.purpose: Tells visits and pages apart so the site's team can see how it is used. The data goes to the site's own Matomo server.
matomo.lifetime: From 30 minutes to 13 months, depending on the cookie.

google.title: Statistics (Google Analytics)
google.purpose: Tells visits and pages apart so the site's team can see how it is used. The data goes to Google.
google.lifetime: From 1 minute to 2 years, depending on the cookie.

referral.title: Referrals
referral.purpose: Remembers which member's invitation link brought you here, so they are credited if you register.

turnstile.title: Security check
turnstile.purpose: Forms for visitors who are not signed in (registration, sign-in, password reset, a new confirmation email) can carry a Cloudflare Turnstile check that tells people from automated abuse. It is strictly necessary for security, so it needs no consent and your choices do not switch it off. Its script is loaded from Cloudflare only on those pages and only while the site has the check turned on; Cloudflare receives your address and browser details to judge it. See Cloudflare's own policy.
turnstile.lifetime: Not stored by this site. Any storage is set by the provider while the check runs.

embeds.title: Embedded content
embeds.purpose: A video or music player from another site is loaded only after you press “Load” or accept this category. Once loaded, that site may set its own cookies; this site cannot see or delete them. See each provider's own policy.
